author: Axiom III
title: Fix exporters: Shallow Block Panel + Summary (JSON union + key fallback)
abstract: Fixes panel/summary exporters to read both JSONL and JSON beacons and detect S1/S2/S3 with underscore-safe fallback.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_shallow_block_panel import export_panel as export_panel_v11
from meta.sas.tools.export_shallow_block_summary_v3 import export as export_summary_v11

p = export_panel_v11(
    agent='Zephyr IV',
    dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
    out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/shallow_block_zephyr_iv_v3.json'
)
s = export_summary_v11(
    agent='Zephyr IV',
    dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
    out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/shallow_block_summary_v3.json'
)
print(json.dumps({"panel": p, "summary": s}, indent=2))
